ig_caption:
Kubernetes ImagePullBackOff caused by ONE character 😩

The deploy said success. The pod never started.
Most people stop at the status. Read the events instead:
"Failed to pull image... repository does not exist"

The tag was kp-app:1.O (the letter O, not a zero).
Kubernetes keeps retrying with a longer back-off each time, but it will never find that image.

The fix:
✅ correct the tag
✅ in real pipelines, never type tags by hand: let the pipeline write the exact tag it just built (commit SHA)

Same deploy → Running.

Save this for your next deploy 🔖 Follow for more Kubernetes breaks.

yt_title: Kubernetes ImagePullBackOff caused by one character #kubernetes
yt_description:
Real run on a local kind cluster: image kp-app:1.O (letter O) instead of kp-app:1.0 → ErrImagePull → ImagePullBackOff.
Debug: kubectl get events (or kubectl describe pod) → "Failed to pull image ... repository does not exist or may require authorization".
Fix: correct the tag; in CI/CD, generate image tags (e.g. the commit SHA) instead of typing them.
